page.title: Library
page.purpose: Find qualified free devices, scenes, presentations and motions by capability, rights and visual suitability.

priorities.statement: Find an asset appropriate for the shot and motion.
Understand qualification, provenance and license before reuse.
Import or create an asset when no qualified choice fits.

states.description: No operation is pending; identify the current task and available next action.
Work is acknowledged and queued or in flight with observed progress or an honest indeterminate state.
A safe retry is actively reconciling or executing without blind duplicate side effects.
Explain the current task, saved revision and next meaningful action.
Name what is loading; retain stable layout and existing local content.
Acknowledge the requested operation once and prevent duplicate costly submissions.
Distinguish local draft changes from durably saved revision; never claim saved early.
Explain local versus remote state and conflict resolution without silently overwriting edits.
Retain usable content and identify the specific information being refreshed.
Explain why there is no content and offer a relevant low-risk first action.
Show which inputs, output or services are available and which remain incomplete.
Show age, affected decisions and explicit refresh; never silently spend on refresh.
Confirm the concrete durable result and offer inspection or the next task.
Associate actionable correction with each invalid field while preserving input.
Explain the failed operation, preserved work and safe next action with diagnostic reference.
Identify the unavailable operation and authority boundary without requesting unrelated access.
Keep supported local work usable; mark online operations unavailable and never auto-submit paid work on reconnect.
Explain whether retry reuses an operation identity, reconciles prior work or starts a newly authorized operation.
Keep broad search available and explain exactly which capability lacks a qualified free asset.
Show unreleased candidates with their remaining checks; do not mix them into approved defaults.

claims.statement: Library cards disclose license attribution obligations, exact model identity and current qualification rather than treating a free listing as inspected geometry.
claims.rationale: Unimplemented design intent; runtime bindings, exact state setup, visual evidence and operator review remain required.

claims.statement: Compatibility filtering preserves required controlled physical motion instead of silently replacing it with a photographic crop.
claims.rationale: Unimplemented design intent; runtime bindings, exact state setup, visual evidence and operator review remain required.

x-design.layout: Search and eight-group facet navigation with curated preview grid/list. Device families, scene context, presentation method and motion capability are explicit filters, not misleading thumbnail decoration.
controls: Search/filter by eight required groups, family, displays, articulation, rights, reference status and render route
Open asset detail and compare variants
Start explicitly labeled AI/agent creation with budget/data preflight
details: Eight accepted representative groups: slab phone; laptop; tablet; foldable/dual-screen; round watch; monitor/TV; smart display/digital frame; embedded vehicle host. Book/flip folds, dual rigid screens and rectangular watches remain explicit family/variant distinctions rather than extra first-release groups. The PRD remains authoritative for exact minimum coverage.
Device, scene, presentation and motion are independent reusable asset kinds; filters expose compatible combinations.
A listing, inspected file, imported candidate, visually reviewed candidate and released asset have different visible states.
A model with no separated lid or joint cannot be advertised as lid-close ready.

x-evidence-policy: No fake selectors, region bindings, setup hooks, captures or attestations. Planned controls are metadata until implemented and grounded.
